articles.title: The story behind the Champions League’s youngest club
articles.summary: Football News: By Dorian MelwinCHENNAI: After an agonizing three-year wait, Manchester United will finally make their return to the Champions League when they play a.
articles.body: By Dorian MelwinCHENNAI: After an agonizing three-year wait, Manchester United will finally make their return to the Champions League when they play against Azerbaijani side Sabah FK. The Red Devils have faced constant disappointment on the European stage ever since their Europa League triumph in 2017. However, when United lifted the trophy on that cold May night in Stockholm, their future opponents Sabah didn’t even exist.Most Azerbaijani clubs are backed by large, multinational conglomerates and Sabah is no different. The club was founded in September 2017 by Yagub Huseynov, chairman of construction conglomerate Bridge Group. The name Sabah means tomorrow in the local Azeri language. However, it is also used figuratively to denote the future. It is rather apt that Sabah was chosen as the name of the club, given the club’s rapid rise.The club entered into the Azerbaijani second division for the 2017-18 season, finishing a respectable 5th in their first season. But in an incredible turn of events, Khazar Baku, who finished 1st in the league, were denied promotion. Three clubs that finished behind Khazar either failed to get the licence for promotion or outright denied it, meaning that Sabah were promoted in their first ever season despite earning 10 points less than the league champions.In their first top-flight campaign, Sabah finished seventh out of eight teams after a disastrous second half of the season. Sabah followed that with a sixth place finish in the 2019-20 season, finishing two points behind the Europa League spots. Two fifth place finishes would follow in subsequent seasons before Sabah finally achieved European qualification in the 2022-23 season, qualifying for the Conference League after finishing second in the league, nine points behind local giants Qarabag.After a third place finish in the 2023-24 season, Sabah would fall back down to fifth in the 2024-25 season. However, the club would also win their first piece of silverware when they won the Azerbaijan Cup. They beat Qarabag 3-2 in the final after Jamaican winger Kaheem Parris converted a penalty to equalize in the seventh minute of added time, taking the game to extra time where winger Tellur Mutallimov scored the winner in the 119th minute.Ahead of the 2025-26 season, Sabah appointed Lithuanian Valdas Dambrauskas as manager. Dambrauskas’s journey is also noteworthy. At the age of 25, Dambrauskas appeared in Lithuania’s version of ‘Who Wants To Be A Millionaire’, where he won 4000 litas. He used this money to move to England, beginning his coaching journey in the lower tiers of English football before travelling around Europe, winning titles in Lithuania, Latvia, Bulgaria and Croatia.Sabah only lost three out of 33 matches to win their maiden Azerbaijan Premier League title, finishing nine points ahead of Qarabag. They also won the Azerbaijan Cup for the second year running, with Rwandan winger Joy-Lance Mickels scoring in added time to beat Zira 2-1, securing a league and cup double in the process.Sabah’s earlier European campaigns were unremarkable, getting knocked out in the qualifying rounds of the Conference League on every occasion. They started their UCL campaign in the first qualifying round, making light work of Welsh side The New Saints by beating them 4-1 on aggregate. After a 3-0 aggregate win over Finnish side KuPS, Sabah caught the global spotlight when they beat Danish champions Aarhus 5-2 on aggregate, setting up a playoff round clash with Israeli champions Hapoel Be’er Sheva.The first leg ended in favour of the Israelis, who beat Sabah 2-1 at a neutral ground in Bucharest. In the second leg, Be’er Sheva scored twice to lead 4-2 on aggregate before Sabah clawed their way back into the game, scoring in the 74thminute before Mutallimov scored in the 4thminute of added time to take the game to extra time. Sabah scored twice in extra time to become the youngest club to qualify for the league phase of the Champions League.For their efforts, Sabah have been handed an extremely tough draw. Apart from the aforementioned away tie against United, the club have been handed glamour ties at home against 5-time UCL champions Barcelona, German giants Borussia Dortmund and Italian heavyweights Napoli. Sabah will end their league phase campaign with an away game against Premier League champions Arsenal.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Ballon d’Or 2026 shortlist revealed: Dembélé, Mbappé, Kane, Messi and Yamal lead star-studded race for football’s biggest prize
articles.summary: Football News: The race for the 2026 Ballon d’Or has officially begun, with defending champion Ousmane Dembélé, Kylian Mbappé, Harry Kane, Lionel Messi and Lamine Ya.
articles.body: The race for the 2026 Ballon d’Or has officially begun, with defending champion Ousmane Dembélé, Kylian Mbappé, Harry Kane, Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal among the biggest names included in the 30-player men’s shortlist announced by France Football on Tuesday.The women’s shortlist also features a host of major contenders, with two-time winner Alexia Putellas, Ewa Pajor and Melchie Dumornay among those hoping to succeed Aitana Bonmatí, who has won the award in each of the past three years but missed much of the season through injury.The winners will be crowned at a ceremony in London on October 26, with the event moving away from its traditional Paris setting to mark the 70th anniversary of the first Ballon d’Or, won by England legend Stanley Matthews in 1956.For Dembélé, the opportunity to become the first player since Bonmatí to retain the award comes after another remarkable season with Paris Saint-Germain. The Frenchman helped PSG win a second consecutive Champions League title, strengthening his claim to remain at the top of the individual game.Yet even Dembélé believes the trophy could stay in Paris regardless of who eventually wins it.“I don't think the trophy is undecided. I think it will remain in the hands of a Paris Saint-Germain player," he said in an interview with France Football.When asked to name his three leading contenders, Dembélé selected PSG teammate Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Kane and Mbappé. He also highlighted Michael Olise, Yamal, Fabian Ruiz and Willian Pacho — but notably left himself out of his own top three.Mbappé believes this could finally be his yearMbappé enters the race having produced one of the most prolific individual campaigns of his career, despite Real Madrid ending the season without a major trophy.The France captain scored 42 goals in 44 appearances for Madrid and also enjoyed a record-breaking World Cup campaign. He claimed the Golden Boot for a second consecutive time with 10 goals and moved beyond Lionel Messi to become the tournament’s all-time leading scorer with 22 goals.His individual numbers have strengthened his belief that he could finally get his hands on the Ballon d’Or after finishing third in 2023.“There are many people who speak about me and the Ballon d’Or. Of course I’ve made history in the most important competition. Maybe it’s a good year for this, but people can vote according to what they think,” Mbappé said on Monday.The French superstar also acknowledged the unique expectations that come with playing for Real Madrid.“I think when you play for Real Madrid, the best club in the world, people automatically associate you with this award,” Mbappé added. “I always think I’m the best, but everyone is entitled to their own opinion.”Asked about comparisons with other leading contenders, Mbappé refused to get drawn into a debate that could quickly become endless.“I don’t like making comparisons because I do a lot of things that others don’t," Mbappé said. "If we get into that it becomes an endless debate, you know?”Kane, Yamal and Messi among the contendersKane has arguably produced one of the strongest seasons of his career, scoring 73 goals for club and country and finally adding major silverware to his collection after helping Bayern Munich win the Bundesliga.Yamal is another major contender after playing a central role in Spain’s World Cup triumph and Barcelona’s La Liga success. His continued rise has put the teenage forward firmly among the game's elite.Messi, meanwhile, remains on the shortlist at 39. The eight-time winner continues to challenge for individual honours after guiding Argentina to a runner-up finish at the World Cup and helping Inter Miami win Major League Soccer.Dembélé and Mbappé both featured for France at the World Cup, where they were eliminated by eventual champions Spain in the semi-finals. While major team trophies traditionally carry significant weight in the Ballon d’Or race, Mbappé’s individual World Cup records could keep him firmly in contention.Bonmatí misses out as women’s race opens upThe women’s award has a notably different complexion this year after Bonmatí was left out of the 30-player shortlist.The Barcelona star had dominated the award, winning three consecutive Ballon d’Or Feminin titles, but an injury kept her out for much of the season. She returned towards the end of Barcelona’s campaign and was able to feature as the club completed a quadruple that included another Champions League triumph.Putellas, a two-time winner, now has an opportunity to reclaim the crown, while Pajor and Dumornay are among the other prominent names in the running.The coaching awards will also be closely watched. World Cup-winning Spain coach Luis de la Fuente and Premier League-winning Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta headline the men's nominees for the Johan Cruyff Trophy.They are joined by Unai Emery of Aston Villa, Vincent Kompany of Bayern Munich and Luis Enrique of Paris Saint-Germain.In the women's category, Jonatan Giraldez, Andree Jeglertz, Nils Nielsen, Pere Romeu and Elena Sadiku have been nominated.How the Ballon d’Or winner is decidedThe Ballon d’Or, created by France Football, has been awarded to men since 1956 and to women since 2018. The men's award is voted on by one journalist from each of the top 100 countries in the FIFA rankings, while the women's award involves journalists from the top 50.Each voter ranks their selections, with points awarded according to the position of each player. The player collecting the most points wins.Organisers say the voting is based on three criteria, in order of importance: individual performances and decisive, impressive character; collective performances and titles won; and class and fair play.With the shortlist now confirmed, Dembélé has the chance to defend his crown, Mbappé is chasing the first Ballon d’Or of his career, Kane is hoping his trophy-laden season can finally translate into individual recognition, while Yamal and Messi add further star power to a race that promises to go down to the wire.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.summary: El equipo de Carlos Geraldo no logró transformar su superioridad en goles
articles.body: El Real Betis inició este martes su participación en la Liga de Campeones Juvenil con un empate sin goles en el campo del Lille francés, que acabó el partido con diez futbolistas al ser expulsado el centrocampista Antoine Goubo en el minuto 89. El árbitro, el maltés Alex Johnson, expulsó al jugador local por hacer falta al bético Miguel Ángel en un encuentro que tras esa circunstancia se alargó cuatro minutos más sin que la formación sevillana pudiera ver portería para arrancar la competición con un triunfo. El Betis de Carlos Geraldo hizo méritos para esa victoria, ya que durante todo el partido tuvo el control del juego y dobló en remates a puerta a su rival y también en los saques de esquina, aunque no fue suficiente para batir la meta defendida por Thomas Sajous. articles.title: Van Bronckhorst: "No le tengo miedo al Barça, pero es el que juega mejor y el partido es un gran reto"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Feyenoord ofrece su visión sobre el cruce de Champions contra el Barça
articles.summary: El técnico del Feyenoord ofrece su visión sobre el cruce de Champions contra el Barça
articles.body: Giovanni van Bronckhorst analizó este martes el cruce del Feyenoord con el Barça. El exjugador azulgrana, que atraviesa su segunda etapa en el banquillo del conjunto de Rotterdam, reconoció el gran momento del Barcelona y la dificultad que tendrá para doblegarle. Pasado culé "Sólo tengo buenos recuerdos. El estadio aún parece más grande. Estuve cuatro años aquí, formo parte de la historia de este club. Ganamos la Champions. Fue un sueño venir aquí. Es muy especial volver. Tengo muchos recuerdos bonitos. Estuve cómodo aquí, con Messi, Ronaldinho... tengo muchos recuerdos. Es extraño jugar contra el Barça, es mi primera vez...". Lamine "Es un reto muy bonito estar aquí y jugar en este escenario. Será un partido difícil. Creo que ha ganado mucho a su edad. Es un jugador de talla mundial. La gente viene al estadio para verlo. Tiene calidad para ganar el Balón de Oro, la pregunta es más cuándo lo ganará y no tanto si lo ganará. Tiene potencial". Barça "No será un partido fácil, el Barça empezó muy bien. Tiene calidad en todas las posiciones. Será muy difícil. Hay que mantener la posesión. Ante un equipo tan bueno es muy difícil. Es el reto que tenemos y es muy bonito. Estar aquí supone tener ganas de mostrar nuestro mejor nivel. Para los jugadores también es una oportunidad de mostrar su desarrollo. No me asusto, me lo tomo como un reto. No me da miedo, me parece un reto bonito. Lo que más me gusta es que juega a lo que todo el mundo quiere ver: circula el balón, tiene rapidez... es un equipo muy completo, con ADN Barça. La gente quiere verlo. Jugamos contra un rival que puede ganar la Champions". Valencia-Barça "Vi el partido. Todo el mundo tiene claro que el Barça está en forma y seguramente sea el que juega mejor. Tenemos que mantener nuestro sitio, estar lejos de nuestra portería. Siempre hay oportunidades y debemos aprovecharlas. Debemos ser valientes y tener el balón. Nos empujarán atrás, y hay que ser valientes e intentar tener la posesión. Podemos acercarnos a su meta y crear juego". Champions "La Champions es diferente a la competición neerlandesa. No tendremos tantas oportunidades y debemos ajustar el juego. También jugamos fuera de casa. Aprendes el nivel, muchos jugadores lo aprenderán. Tenemos mucho que ganar. Para muchos jugadores es un partido de primer nivel. Hay que ser valientes e intentar que no se note la diferencia de nivel". Moussa "Está muy bien. Él tomó decisiones en el partido que no nos gustaron. Tuvo problemas de disciplina. No se concretó el traspaso, pero ha hecho un cambio. Él decidió seguir. Tenemos que gestionarlo. La conversación fue seria y dejamos el tema atrás. Es un jugador que puede marcar la diferencia. Habló con sus compañeros. Queremos plantear un equipo que sea peligroso". Mármol "Con las lesiones, está jugando más de lateral que de central. Para él es un reto jugar contra Lamine, para él y para todo el equipo". Barça "Este equipo ha ganado dos ligas y quiere ganar la Champions. Ganarla fue el hito de mi carrera".

articles.title: Alineaciones probables del partido de Champions del Barça vs Feyenoord
articles.standfirst: Flick está obligado a introducir al menos un cambio
articles.summary: Flick está obligado a introducir al menos un cambio
articles.body: El Barça afronta este miércoles el primer encuentro de esta edición de la Champions League. Flick, que tiene la baja por sanción de Eric García, lo abordará con un once tan competitivo como en forma. El Barcelona no puede disponer para el cruce contra el Feyenoord, que se disputa en el Spotify Camp Nou, con los lesionados Frenkie de Jong y Roony ni con el sancionado Eric García. El cuadro azulgrana llega al encuentro continental en el mejor momento de su historia: ha ganado sus cuatro primeros partidos de LaLiga y su balance es de 17 goles a favor y sólo dos en contra. Destaca el gran momento de algunos de sus jugadores, como Raphinha (Pichichi con seis goles), Lamine, Fermín, Olmo, Rodri, Pedri, Joan García... El Feyenoord, tercero de la Eredivise, tiene las ausencias confirmadas por lesión de Nieuwkoop Bos, Moder, y Smal, pero finalmente viajó Moussa, que tuvo problemas de disciplina. El conjunto neerlandés está dirigido por el exdefensa azulgrana Giovanni van Bronckhorst, que vive su segunda etapa en el banquillo del club neerlandés. Alineación probable del Barcelona: Joan García; Koundé, Gerard Martín, Cubarsí, Espart; Rodri, Pedri; Lamine, Fermín, Raphinha y Gordon. articles.title: Messi alcanza un principio de acuerdo para comprar el Eldense, de Segunda división
articles.standfirst: El astro argentino se afianza como empresario en el fútbol español, pues ya adquirió el Cornellá
articles.summary: El astro argentino se afianza como empresario en el fútbol español, pues ya adquirió el Cornellá
articles.body: Lionel Messi ha alcanzado un principio de acuerdo para adquirir en propiedad el Eldense, equipo de la Segunda división española, iniciando así su presencia, si es que se confirma la compra, como empresario en el fútbol profesional español y afianzándola tras la adquisición este mismo año del UE Cornellà, equipo de la Tercera Federación catalana. Messi adquiriría el cien por cien de las acciones, sin intervención de terceros. La acción empresarial de Messi responde a su deseo de invertir su legado en el propio fútbol, esta vez con un club recién ascendido a la Segunda división español y con sede en Elda, provincia de Alicante, no tan lejos de Cataluña, que es donde piensa vivir cuando el astro abandone el fútbol en activo en el Inter Miami. Leo Messi, ha alcanzado un principio de acuerdo con los actuales propietarios del CD Eldense para convertirse en el máximo accionista del club alicantino. De completarse la operación, se podría formalizar en los próximos días, una vez concluyan los últimos trámites legales y contractuales, entre ellos el proceso de 'due diligence'. También quedará sujeta a la preceptiva autorización del Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD). El Eldense fue comprado hace un tiempo por un grupo inversor internacional con ascendencia colombiana liderado por el empresario Juan Carlos Trujillo, que le compró el club a su vez a Pascual Pérez en octubre de 2025. También se había rumoreado que el argentino Ricardo Pini tenía intención de adquirirlo por unos 12 millones de euros en estos últimos meses. Pero el nombre de Messi irrumpe en escena con la fuerza de un ciclón. Deportivamente, el Eldense destituyó este pasado lunes a Claudio Barragán, el primer entrenador de Segunda en caer. El equipo apenas ha podido conseguir dos puntos en cuatro jornadas de Liga. Aún no tiene nuevo entrenador.

articles.title: Uno a uno del Real Madrid contra el Inter: Brahim se pone al volante de la BMV
articles.standfirst: Análisis de la actuación de los jugadores y de Mourinho
articles.summary: Análisis de la actuación de los jugadores y de Mourinho
articles.body: El Madrid acabó sufriendo en un partido que debió liquidar mucho antes. Pero Mbappé, Vinicius y Bellingham volvieron a estar desacertados de cara a puerta y condenaron al Madrid a un sufrimiento innecesario que puso en riesgo el triunfo. Con el partido roto y con Brahim desatado y convertido en un generador de ocasiones constantes, la BMV volvió a pecar de falta de pegada. El Inter, que siempre estuvo vivo en el partido, puso en muchos aprietos a un Madrid en el que Courtois fue uno de los destacados. PRIMERA PARTE: Decisivo para sujetar al Inter en los minutos iniciales. Gran parada en una volea a bocajarro de Thuram. Buena parada abajo en un tiro de Lautaro. Paró como pudo un 'misil' de Calhanoglu en el lanzamiento de una falta desde la frontal. Se llevó un durísimo golpe con Lautaro. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 8 SEGUNDA PARTE: Tuvo muchísimo trabajo. Saca otra gran mano para negarle el gol al Inter. Tremenda doble parada en una acción que se anularía por fuera de juego. Otro mano increíble abajo en un tiro envenenado de Bastoni. NOTA FINAL: 9 PRIMERA PARTE: Dando prioridad absoluta a la vigilancia defensiva. Proyectándose poco o nada en ataque. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 SEGUNDA PARTE: Un partido de experiencia y madurez. Bien interpretado por su parte. Era un día para cubrirse en defensa y lo hizo. No le faltó trabajo atrás. NOTA FINAL: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Sólido en el marcaje al hombre. Atento y contundente en los duelos. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 SEGUNDA PARTE: Trabajó de lo lindo para sujetar las acometidas del Inter. El Madrid no se juntó todo lo que debería en un partido abierto y había muchos 'agujeros' que tapar. NOTA FINAL: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Muy consistente. Ganando en confianza y creciendo en su rendimiento. En un gran momento de confianza. Muy presente en los primeros minutos en los que el Inter inquietó el área de Courtois. Dos buenos despejes, uno de ellos ronzando el gol en propia puerta en un tiro peligroso de Calhanoglu. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 SEGUNDA PARTE: El partido lo llevó al límite de la exigencia defensiva porque el Inter no dejó de atacar y de intimidar. Respondió a esa exigencia y aguantó el tipo. Tuvo que lidiar con infinidad de duelos y acciones defensivas y lo hizo a un gran nivel. NOTA FINAL: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Muy concentrado en tareas defensivas. Es un muro en los duelos y su atención es oro para el Madrid en momentos de sufrimiento. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 SEGUNDA PARTE: No hizo concesiones defensivas en ningún momento. Su concentración es una garantía total. NOTA FINAL: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Muy comprometido en las ayudas y correcciones defensivas. Buena acción defensiva para interceptar una arrancada de Diouf. La fe que pone siempre en la presión tuvo una recompensa inesperada. Su agresividad en la presión tuvo premio en el 2-0, robando el balón al meta Josep Martínez y marcando. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 7 SEGUNDA PARTE: Con el partido roto y con muchos jugadores del Madrid a la carrera en busca de la contra definitiva, se contuvo para las vigilancias porque el Inter no dejó de amenazar en ningún momento. La conexión con Trent no terminó de funcionar y le obligó a un esfuerzo extra. NOTA FINAL: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Sin brillo, pero sin descuidar su compromiso táctico y defensivo. Desaparecido en el entramado defensivo del Inter. Buen robo de balón que habilitó a Vinicius para una contra peligrosa. Forzó una amarilla a Calhanoglu. Josep Martínez le negó el gol con un paradón en su única aparición por el área del Inter. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 SEGUNDA PARTE: No tuvo la inspiración con el balón de otras ocasiones, pero es un 'guerrero' en el campo. Su intensidad defensiva le dio mucho al equipo. Falla un gol cantado, estropeando una jugada mágica de Brahim. Pudiendo cabecear a puerta vacía, decide controlar con el pecho y pierde toda la ventaja en el remate final. NOTA FINAL: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Saliendo airoso del experimento de formar pareja en el centro del campo con Valverde. Haciendo un gran esfuerzo físico y táctico para responder a la exigencia de la posición. Fallón en el apartado más inesperado: con el balón. Dejó varios pases imprecisos que complicaron al equipo. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 SEGUNDA PARTE: Superado. Sufrió cada vez más para contener el caudal ofensivo del Inter. Incómodo y perdido. El experimento no terminó de funcionar y fue un punto débil que Mou tuvo que corregir con Tchouaméni. NOTA FINAL: 4 PRIMERA PARTE: Sus eléctricos 'fogonozos' siempre suman. Afilado, listo y con detalles de calidad. Asistió en el primer gol. Todo un 'guerrero' en la presión. Desgaste descomunal. No acierta a encontrar a Mbappé tras un robo peligroso de balón en la presión. Muy atento para aprovechar un error de Bisseck en la salida de balón y habilitar de primeras a Mbappé en la acción del 1-0. Espectacular toque de primeras en una contra para dejar solo a Mbappé ante el portero. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 7 SEGUNDA PARTE: Sobresaliente. Una tortura permanente para el Inter. El jugador más inspirado del partido. Dio asistencias de todos los colores que no se aprovecharon. Espectacular acción individual dentro del área que resuelve con una asistencia a Bellingham que el inglés falla de manera incomprensible. Habilitó con un taconazo una contra peligrosa de Mbappé. Le regaló otro gol a Mbappé que esta vez el francés desaprovechó. NOTA FINAL: 9 PRIMERA PARTE: Letal y dando sensación de peligro a la contra. Primera ocasión, primer gol. Recibió un pase de Brahim tras robo que lo dejó solo ante Josep Martínez y no perdonó. Cerró el primer tiempo con una acción personal galáctica con la que rozó el doblete. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 7 SEGUNDA PARTE: El partido estuvo para que lo hubiese 'matado' con varios goles más. Pero volvió a estar fallón y poco clarividente en la definición. En su mano estuvo liquidar el partido mucho antes. Tuvo una gran ocasión tras la reanudación, pero se enredó en el mano a mano ante el portero. NOTA FINAL: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Las ovaciones se las ha llevado por acciones defensivas. El Bernabéu le recompensó por defender. En ataque poco, pero dañino cada vez que ha podido correr. Pidió penalti tras una potente arrancada por el carril central, pero Pavard le sacó el balón 'in extremis' limpiamente. Lidera una espectacular contra que a punto está de resolver Mbappé. Espectacular ayuda defensiva para abortar un remate de Calhanoglu que era medio gol. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 SEGUNDA PARTE: Comprometido en labores defensivas, pero con poquísimo brillo ofensivo. Muchas arrancadas que no acabaron en nada y una sensación de bloqueo extraña en un jugador de su talento. Coleccionó contragolpes en los que ni se acercó al jugador demoledor que es en esos escenarios de partido con tanto espacio para correr. NOTA FINAL: 5 SEGUNDA PARTE: Entra por Brahim en el 79'. Sin calificar. SEGUNDA PARTE: Entra por Trent en el 79'. Sin calificar. SEGUNDA PARTE: Entra por Vinicius en el 86'. Sin calificar. SEGUNDA PARTE: Entra por Mbappé en el 92'. Sin calificar. PRIMERA PARTE: El equipo resistió el arreón inicial del Inter y supo penalizar los errores del rival para encarrilar el partido. Tras el 2-0, el Madrid se tranquilizó y mantuvo más a raya a un Inter que amenazó de inicio. El Madrid no tiene el control del partido, pero está generando peligro a la contra. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 SEGUNDA PARTE: Con el Madrid incapaz de cerrar el partido a la contra, el equipo concedió demasiadas llegadas al Inter por su falta de control y de dominio del encuentro. articles.body:
Oregon moved down and LSU moved up in the first regular-season AP Top 25 poll.

The Ducks dropped four spots from No. 2 to No. 6 after a 34-27 win over Boise State , while LSU moved from No. 11 to No. 8 after a 51-10 win over Clemson on Saturday night .

Michigan, meanwhile, fell out of the top 25 entirely after its literal last-second win over Western Michigan . The Wolverines were third among teams also receiving votes outside the top 25 after starting the season at No. 16.

Ohio State stayed at No. 1 while Georgia moved up to the No. 2 spot. Notre Dame , Texas and Indiana fill out the top five. After Oregon, the top 10 is filled out by Miami, LSU, Ole Miss and Texas A&M.

articles.title: Así juega el Inter, rival del Real Madrid hoy en el debut de la Champions League
articles.standfirst: El Inter de Milán llega al Santiago Bernabéu como una de las potencias más sólidas del fútbol italiano. El conjunto transalpino busca dar un golpe sobre la mesa en este estreno europeo.
articles.summary: El Inter de Milán llega al Santiago Bernabéu como una de las potencias más sólidas del fútbol italiano. El conjunto transalpino busca dar un golpe sobre la mesa en este estreno europeo.
articles.body: El equipo dirigido por Cristian Chivu mantiene la competitividad y capacidad de sufrimiento que le llevaron a disputar finales continentales recientemente. Los fichajes de John Stones o Curtis Jones aportan nuevas variantes tácticas a una plantilla llena de experiencia. El bloque italiano destaca por su notable solidez defensiva general. En la parcela ofensiva, la dupla formada por Lautaro Martínez y Marcus Thuram representa la principal amenaza para la zaga madridista. Los visitantes explotan con enorme precisión las transiciones rápidas. Además, llegan reforzados tras remontar al Nápoles en la Serie A, mostrando un excelente estado de forma competitivo. El planteamiento 'nerazzurro' prioriza el orden táctico sin balón para cerrar espacios interiores al rival. Chivu busca presionar con intensidad en zonas medias antes de salir al contragolpe con velocidad. Esta estructura convierte al Inter en un visitante incómodo y peligroso en cualquier escenario de máxima exigencia europea. A pesar de la baja de Federico Dimarco, el conjunto milanés conserva recursos para amenazar a balón parado. El choque ante los blancos servirá para medir sus verdaderas opciones de liderar la clasificación única. El Inter saltará al césped madrileño dispuesto a competir cada balón con máxima intensidad.

articles.title: Quién es Georgi Kabakov, árbitro del Lille - Betis de hoy en Champions League
articles.standfirst: El colegiado búlgaro Georgi Kabakov ha sido designado para arbitrar el encuentro entre el Lille y el Real Betis
articles.summary: El colegiado búlgaro Georgi Kabakov ha sido designado para arbitrar el encuentro entre el Lille y el Real Betis
articles.body: La primera jornada de la fase de liga contará con la dirección de un árbitro con amplia experiencia europea. Georgi Kabakov, nacido en Plovdiv en 1986, es un juez colegiado internacional desde el año 2013. Habitual en la Primera Liga de su país, el colegiado búlgaro ha dirigido numerosos partidos en competiciones continentales de primer nivel como la Liga de Campeones, la Europa League y diversos torneos internacionales. A lo largo de su trayectoria internacional, el árbitro ha dirigido a varios conjuntos del fútbol español. Curiosamente, su debut oficial en la máxima competición de la UEFA se produjo en Mestalla durante el año 2018, en un choque donde el Valencia logró imponerse exitosamente ante el Manchester United. Kabakov guarda un recuerdo muy positivo para la selección española en categorías inferiores. El búlgaro fue el encargado de impartir justicia en las semifinales del Europeo sub-21 de 2019, cita en la que el combinado nacional logró una contundente victoria por cuatro goles a uno frente a Francia. A pesar de acumular choques de máxima exigencia internacional, la carrera del colegiado búlgaro ha tenido altibajos recientísimos. La federación de su país lo apartó temporalmente de las asignaciones arbitrales tras un desempeño insatisfactorio desde la sala VAR, pero regresa ahora para impartir justicia en el duelo continental.

articles.title: Así juega el Borussia Dortmund, rival del Villarreal hoy en el debut de la Champions League
articles.standfirst: El Borussia Dortmund recibe al Villarreal en el Signal Iduna Park en su estreno en la Champions League
articles.summary: El Borussia Dortmund recibe al Villarreal en el Signal Iduna Park en su estreno en la Champions League
articles.body: El equipo alemán pretende imponer su habitual ritmo vertiginoso ante su afición. A pesar de haber vendido este verano a figuras importantes como Julian Brandt o Karim Adeyemi, el club germano se ha rearmado con jóvenes talentos. La plantilla dirigida por Niko Kovac combina juventud y potencia física, destacando la presencia de Serhou Guirassy como gran referencia goleadora en el ataque. El esquema de Kovac se fundamenta en una firme defensa de tres centrales y gran presencia física en la medular. El inglés Jobe Bellingham y Felix Nmecha sostienen el ritmo de juego, permitiendo al equipo presionar muy arriba. Sin embargo, sufren la baja por grave lesión del joven Konstantelias. El estadio de Dortmund genera una atmósfera intimidante que condiciona los partidos desde el inicio. El equipo local busca arrinconar a sus rivales mediante transiciones eléctricas y ataques verticales constantes. Esta agresividad ofensiva suele traducirse en un elevado número de ocasiones generadas durante los primeros noventa minutos. El Submarino Amarillo deberá extremar las precauciones para no repetir tropiezos pasados en tierras alemanas. Minimizar las pérdidas de balón en el centro del campo resultará vital para contener las acometidas germanas. El Dortmund parte como favorito para sumar sus tres primeros puntos de la fase liga.

articles.title: El AEK de Luka Jovic inaugura la Champions con triunfo al LASK
articles.standfirst: El exariete madridista marcó un tanto pero se lo anularon
articles.summary: El exariete madridista marcó un tanto pero se lo anularon
articles.body: El AEK Atenas empezó la Champions League con triunfo ante el austríaco LASK Linz (1-0) gracias a un único tanto marcado por el rumano Razvan Marin merced a un espectacular tiro directo de falta en la primera parte. El AEK, en su regreso a la Champions tras ocho años fuera, tuvo opciones para rematar la faena en la segunda parte, en la que perdonó cuatro goles claros. Luka Jovic fue autor de un tanto, pero le fue anulado finalmente. Jovic no pude engordar sus cifras en el club griego. Hoy cumplía 50 partidos, con 25 goles marcados. Pero, en Champions, el jugador serbio aún no ha podido estrenar su casillero en sus etapas con Real Madrid, Milan, Benfica y AEK (13 partidos en total). El equipo austríaco de Linz, que dio la sorpresa en los 'playoffs' ante el Celtic metiéndose para meterse la fase Liga, tuvo también opciones en la segunda mitad, en especial una del mítico Kaladjzic, que falló increíblemente. El LASK, entrenado por el exjugador realista Kühbauer, no se mereció el empate ante un AEK que fue superior en líneas generales.

articles.title: Arda y Mbappé, premiados antes del Inter

articles.summary: Jugador revelación y máximo goleador de la pasada edición de la Champions
articles.body: En unos prolegómenos del partidos que incluyeron numeroso actos, como el minuto de silencio por las víctimas de Nepal y China y el apoyo expreso del Bernabéu a Ceuta, la UEFA otorgó dos premios a jugadores del Madrid por los méritos contraidos en la pasada edición de la Champions. No hubo título blanco (el Madrid cayó eliminado en cuartos ante el Bayern), pero la UEFA distinguió a Arda Güler, bigoleador en el Allianz, como el jugador revelación de la última edición de la Copa de Europa. Un premio que el turco, sancionado para el partido de esta noche ante el Inter, recibió vestido de paisano. A continuación, fue Mbappé el que recibió su trofeo como máximo goleador de la pasada Champions. Los 15 goles en 11 partidos del delantero francés no pudieron ser superados por ningún otro atacante (harry Kane fue el que más se acercó), por lo que Kylian suma al Pichichi obtenido en la Liga 25-26 el trofeo de mejor artillero de Europa. Ambos jugadores del Madrid recibieron sus galardones de manos de Luis Figo, también exjugador del club blanco.

articles.title: Por qué el Inter juega sin publicidad en su camiseta en el partido de Champions contra el Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: Ambos debutan en la máxima competición continental
articles.summary: Ambos debutan en la máxima competición continental
articles.body: El Inter de Milán afronta su duelo ante el Real Madrid con una imagen poco habitual: su camiseta aparece sin el patrocinador principal que luce habitualmente en el pecho. La razón no está en una decisión deportiva ni en una medida adoptada por el conjunto blanco o por la UEFA, sino en la legislación española sobre publicidad de apuestas. El principal patrocinador del Inter, Betsson.Sport, pertenece al sector del juego y las apuestas deportivas. La normativa vigente en España establece importantes restricciones a la publicidad de operadores de juego, especialmente en acontecimientos deportivos y en soportes como las camisetas de los equipos. Por este motivo, el club italiano ha tenido que adaptar su equipación para disputar el encuentro en territorio español y retirar temporalmente el logotipo de su patrocinador. Se trata de una obligación relacionada con el lugar en el que se disputa el partido, no de una prohibición general que afecte al Inter durante toda la temporada. La medida genera una estampa curiosa en el Santiago Bernabéu, con un Inter que mantiene intactos sus tradicionales colores nerazzurri, pero que prescinde de uno de los elementos comerciales más reconocibles de su equipación. En otros países y competiciones donde la legislación lo permite, el patrocinador puede volver a aparecer con normalidad en la camiseta.

articles.title: La Champions se estrena sin lona en el Bernabéu
articles.standfirst: La ceremonia inaugural de la Champions se celebró en el Bernabéu sin la tradicional lona en el círculo central, una ausencia que no se dio en el resto de estadios de la jornada
articles.summary: La ceremonia inaugural de la Champions se celebró en el Bernabéu sin la tradicional lona en el círculo central, una ausencia que no se dio en el resto de estadios de la jornada
articles.body: Sonaba la melodía de la Champions League en el Santiago Bernabéu en el inicio de la misma una temporada más. Todo parecía normal, menos el centro del campo. La circunferencia, que solía estar ocupada por la gran lona circular con el logo repleto de estrellas del torneo, no hacía acto de presencia esta vez. Esta vez el mítico himno de la máxima competición continental no iba acompañada por la lona vibrando en medio del verde. Sin embargo, solo ocurrió en el Santiago Bernabéu. En el resto de partidos de la jornada inicial, dicha lona ocupaba el centro del campo y la ceremonia transcurría con la normalidad de siempre. Dejando a un lado ese detalle, el fondo del Santiago Bernabéu se volcó con Ceuta. La grada de animación se llenó banderas de la Ciudad Autónoma durante un minuto, al grito de "¡Ceuta no se vende, Ceuta se defiende!". Un homenaje que nació por parte de las peñas de dicha grada de animación. En cuanto a actos oficiales se refiere, se reservó un minuto de silencio por las víctimas de la riada de la Nepal y China. Algo que ocurrió en todos los partidos de la jornada de Champions y también en el Bernabéu semanas atrás en el partido contra el Málaga.

articles.title: Pregón de fiestas y a revivir el sueño del minuto 97
articles.standfirst: El Rayo Majadahonda es el pregonero de las fiestas de la localidad y, un día después, partido ante el Cartagena
articles.summary: El Rayo Majadahonda es el pregonero de las fiestas de la localidad y, un día después, partido ante el Cartagena
articles.body: Hay cosas que el destino se encarga de juntar. Rayo Majadahonda y Cartagena tienen desde el 27 de mayo de 2018 una Historia en común. Feliz para el Rayo Majadahonda de Antonio Iriondo y cruel para el equipo albinegro y los 1.500 seguidores que después del 2-1 de la ida se plantaron en el Cerro del Espino pensando en que iban a celebrar, por fin, el ascenso a Segunda. Nadie se olvida en Majadahonda de aquella mañana. Del gol en el minuto 97 en propia puerta de Michel Zabaco. Una jugada que cambió el guion previsto y que sirvió para que, por primera vez en su Historia, y ante la incredulidad de un público que abarrotaba el Cerro del Espino, como nunca antes, el Rayo Majadahonda se convirtiera de la noche a la mañana en equipo de Segunda División. Aquel día cambio la Historia del club para siempre. Una Historia, que esta temporada vive de celebración por su 50 Aniversario y por el ascenso de categoría logrado el pasado año a Primera Federación, un logro deportivo que ha servido para retomar la confianza en un nuevo proyecto de la mano de Javier Ruiz Poo. Tras dos primeros partidos de Liga no podía haber otro rival mejor para el duelo en plenas fiestas patronales de la localidad que el Cartagena. Y más cuando, la noche de antes, la del viernes, el club tendrá el honor de ser el gran protagonista de las Fiestas de Majadahonda en el pregón que ofrecerá desde el balcón del Ayuntamiento el eterno presidente Enrique Vedia (46 años en la Directiva del club majariego y desde 1982 como presidente), un jugador de la cantera Pablo Bustos y un integrante del primer equipo Dani Ramos. Si bien es cierto que la suerte le ha sido esquiva en estos dos primeros partidos al equipo de Guillermo Fernández, con sendas derrotas en el tiempo de descuento ante Villarreal B e Ibiza, nadie se quiere perder en la localidad el duelo ante el Cartagena. Son recuerdos muy profundos en el seno del club y desde luego que, aunque han pasado ya ocho temporadas, el minuto 97 siempre estará presente en el Cerro del Espino.

articles.summary: El Ayuntamiento de la localidad plantea 50.000 euros por partido
articles.body: El Ayuntamiento de Leganés se plantea cobrar 50.000 euros al Rayo Vallecano por cada partido que dispute en Butarque si necesita el Rayo Vallecano continuar utilizando el estadio pepinero. El alcalde de Leganés, Miguel Ángel Recuenco, ha dejado clara la postura del consistorio ante la posibilidad de que la situación se prolongue. "Los leganenses no podemos estar asumiendo los gastos derivados de estos partidos más allá de la ayuda circunstancial que se ha producido ya", señaló. Desde el Ayuntamiento entienden que la colaboración prestada hasta ahora responde a una situación excepcional, pero consideran que una continuidad del Rayo en Butarque debe ir acompañada de una compensación económica por los costes que supone para la ciudad. articles.title: Sources: CFP leaders trigger 30-day negotiating window with ESPN, furthering consideration for playoff expansion
articles.summary: While the move is not necessarily a commitment to expand, the decision would signal a serious interest in exploring the worth of a 24-team playoff field.
articles.body:
The road to an expanded playoff is on the cusp of reaching its next milestone.

College Football Playoff leaders have decided to trigger a mandatory 30-day negotiating window with ESPN as they pursue the value of expansion options, sources tell Yahoo Sports.

The move, if it happens, is not necessarily a commitment to expand. However, the decision signals a strong interest in exploring the worth of a 24-team playoff field, the most-discussed option that has garnered support within the room of playoff officials.

The decision would follow what seems to be growing momentum from the SEC and commissioner Greg Sankey in a larger playoff format. Sankey distributed a memo to CFP Management Committee members about a week ago outlining considerations if he were to agree to a 24-team field.

One of the considerations is requiring teams to play 10 "qualifying events" to be eligible for the CFP. Qualifying events consist of (1) conference games; (2) games against Notre Dame; and (3) games against power conference teams — a concept that would require teams to play 10 power league games, at minimum.

Big Ten commissioner Tony Petitti has expressed openness to the scheduling concept, which would alter the Big Ten's existing scheduling philosophy. The Big Ten remains the only power league that does not require its schools to play a non-conference game against a power conference team.

The negotiating window, a concept within ESPN's six-year contract as the playoff's media partner, is required before playoff executives open bidding to the market. Network officials have 30 days to make their best offer, which playoff leaders can either accept, or reject and move to the open market.

The CFP Management Committee — the 10 FBS conference commissioners and Notre Dame's athletic director — met on a call last week to further discuss the matter, as On3 reported last week . A second call Tuesday moved executives more toward triggering the window.

Triggering the negotiating window would give playoff officials flexibility to meet the Dec. 1 deadline — a contractual date in which leaders must decide if the current 12-team field will expand in time for next year's playoff.

Already, the networks have pushed back a deadline for the conferences to notify them that leagues are eliminating their conference championship games — a necessary move in any 24-team expanded bracket. That deadline is also expected to align with the CFP expansion date of Dec. 1.

For months now, CFP leaders have been embroiled in negotiations over expanding upon the 12-team field. The SEC and Big Ten hold authority over any format change, which means the two conferences must agree on a format for it to move forward.

The SEC has been entrenched in a 16-team format while the Big Ten has supported a 24-team field. For at least 18 months now, the industry's titans and their commissioners, Greg Sankey (SEC) and Tony Petitti (Big Ten), have supported different concepts.

In January, Petitti opposed a move to 16 teams during CFP meetings ahead of the national championship game in Miami, halting any expansion despite all other management committee members being aligned behind the model. A few months later, Sankey found himself in the minority during meetings this spring, as commissioners of the ACC and Big 12 and Notre Dame athletic director Pete Bevacqua threw their support behind a 24-team model of all at-large selections (aside from one Group of Six automatic bid).

While Sankey and some of his presidents have expressed reservations and concerns over a 24-team field, many of the SEC's coaches and athletic directors publicly, and certainly privately, support such a model. There are signs that the SEC is moving closer to more formal support of a larger field.

However, Sankey believes the SEC must recuperate the revenue lost from eliminating the league's title game — a figure believed to be around $100 million.

At the center of the expansion discussion is, indeed, money. A 16-team playoff generates very little additional revenue as ESPN controls the rights for an increase up to 14 teams. That means limited new inventory is available to an open market of broadcast companies.

A 24-team playoff not only doubles the field and creates 12 new games. However, the move must come with a significant increase in revenue — at least $250 million, CFP leaders privately say — to compensate for the cancellation of the four conference championship games. The distribution of any additional revenue stands to brew into a contentious negotiation among conferences.

Another issue in an expansion to 24 is the Army-Navy game, traditionally played on the second Saturday of December. In the most discussed 24-team model, Army-Navy would move to the Saturday currently occupied by the conference title games. A 24-team playoff's first round — eight games — would not start until the second weekend of December.

articles.title: El doblete de Haaland fue demasiado para el muro de Diogo Costa
articles.standfirst: Un par de zarpazos del noruego son suficientes para el Manchester City en el Estadio do Dragão
articles.summary: Un par de zarpazos del noruego son suficientes para el Manchester City en el Estadio do Dragão
articles.body: Arrancaba la era 'post Pep Guardiola' para el Manchester City de Enzo Maresca en Europa y lo hacía ante el rocoso Oporto de Farioli en el espectacular estadio de Do Dragão. Un encuentro que sería figura Diogo Costa en la primera mitad con paradas de mucho mérito, sobre todo, una doble intervención a Haaland y Cherki. Sería en el inicio de la segunda mitad cuando el noruego marcara un cabezazo que no podía parar el arquero luso y poner el 0-1. Hubo tiempo para el segundo del noruego en la recta final del partido. Salió en 'tromba' el Oporto y no es una referencia a la gran lluvia que comenzó a caer en do Dragão. Muy participativos los lusos en el tramo inicial conectando muchos pases con un Manchester City que prefirió esperar atrás a sus rivales. Todo el ritmo que tenía el partido era sin ocasiones: ningún disparo de los dos equipos en los 10 primeros minutos. Tuvo una gran ocasión Gabri Veiga que paró con el pie Donnarumma... pero la jugada estaba anulada por fuera de juego. La tuvo Haaland de cabeza con un cabezazo que paró de forma milagrosa Diogo Costa. Los 'cityzens' comenzaban a sentirse más cómodos en el partido. El monólogo de los ingleses en este tramo del partido comenzó a ser evidente y la volvió a tener Foden, pero apareció el portero luso para parar de nuevo la ocasión visitante. Este último se estaba emergiendo como el mejor jugador en la primera mitad con otras dos atajadas de muchísimo nivel. Vio la amarilla Gvardiol, la primera del partido, en una contra de William Gomes. Sería de lo poquito positivo que pudo sacar el conjunto luso en la primera mitad. Quedó conmocionado Gabri Veiga tras un codazo que soltó Guehi que no pitó ni falta el árbitro, parecía incluso una acción de tarjeta amarilla. Poco después y casi sin jugarse casi nada, se iría el encuentro al descanso. No podía empezar mejor la segunda mitad para el Manchester City: gol de Haaland de cabeza en un testarazo imparable para la portería de Diogo Costa y se ponían por delante los cityzens. Un ritmo que cada vez sería más complicado de seguir para los lusos...aunque la tuvo Varela con un gran golpeo de fuera del área que casi entra en la portería de Donnarumma. A pesar del buen juego del City, se puso nervioso Haaland con sus compañeros y se le pudo ver algo alterado en alguna ocasión que otra. Susto tremendo el que tuvieron los ingleses con la mala salida de Donnarumma que casi llega William Gomes. Los lusos peleaban por el empate, pero les era complicado tener ocasiones de peligro ante la buena actividad de la zaga cityzen. Un Manchester City que jugó en la recta final sabiendo aguantar el resultado en do Dragão. El Oporto físicamente estaba muy cansado y apenas pudieron mostrar un par de chispazos ante la atenta mirada de Donnarumma. Un final de partido que acabó siendo digno del primer partido de la temporada en Champions en Septiembre... aunque hubo tiempo para el segundo del noruego en el descuento del partido y para la amarilla en una tangana con Rosario.

articles.title: Jerry Sandusky reportedly withdraws recantation claim, aiming for new trial in higher court
articles.summary: Sandusky and his legal team changed course and decided to no longer proceed with testimony from one of Sandusky's 10 accusers, who sought to recant his alleg...
articles.body:
Former Penn State defensive coordinator Jerry Sandusky agreed over Zoom from a state prison in southwestern Pennsylvania to withdraw a recantation claim in Centre County Court on Tuesday, according to multiple reports .

The evidentiary hearing was part of the 82-year-old Sandusky's latest attempt to secure a new trial in a higher court, more than a decade after he was convicted of 45 counts of child sexual abuse in 2012 and sentenced to 30-60 years in prison, a scandal that was deleterious to Penn State football and ultimately resulted in the firing of legendary head coach Joe Paterno .

The hearing occurred even after Sandusky's attorneys filed a withdrawal motion last week . Sandusky and his legal team changed course and decided to no longer proceed with testimony from one of Sandusky's 10 accusers, who sought to recant his allegations that Sandusky abused him in the late '90s .

That accuser, who was 24 at the time of his first interview with the Pennsylvania State Police in November 2011 and was previously known as "Victim 10" in court documents, alleged that he was "misled repeatedly" by prosecutors, according to a signed affidavit from June 30, 2025.

Victim 10 wrote that he made statements during Sandusky's 2012 criminal trial that were "induced under extreme psychological and institutional pressure." He said his testimony evolved as the result of "emotional strain, repeated exposure to leading questions, intense investigative pressure and psychological manipulation." And he recalled being coached during pretrial meetings, in which he purported that he was "repeatedly asked to revisit and reframe" his story until his responses "aligned with what appeared to be desired by the prosecution team."

In the affidavit, Victim 10 specifically called out lead prosecutor Joe McGettigan, who died in December.

The lone recantation claim was supposed to be the center of Tuesday's hearing — that is, until Sandusky's lawyers pivoted.

On Tuesday, Sandusky reportedly affirmed that strategy change. He testified that he wasn't pressured, threatened or offered assurances for dropping the claim, according to the Centre Daily Times .

It was Sandusky's first public appearance since 2019, according to The Athletic , which noted in its report that Sandusky mostly provided one-word answers in an occasionally shaky voice to Judge Maureen Skerda and that Sandusky had visibly less hair than seven years ago. Plus, Sandusky reportedly struggled to hear questions through the video stream.

"He's got heart issues. He's delayed a heart surgery. He's 82 years of age, you saw him if you were in the courtroom," said Jerry Russo, Sandusky's attorney, outside the courthouse after the hearing," per The Athletic.

Sandusky's legal team was dismayed that the court didn't hear additional claims offered in an appeal last year and has been chagrined by the court's previous dismissals of Sandusky's pursuit of a new trial, per ESPN .

Russo told assembled media, according to the Centre Daily Times , that this claim was withdrawn because recantation claims are seen as "inherently unreliable."

"If that's the only issue that remains for us to litigate, there's no purpose to deserve litigating here in state court," Russo said, via the Centre Daily Times.

articles.title: Texas football's red-zone struggles have haunted Longhorns' last two losses to Ohio State
articles.summary: The Texas Longhorns have struggled in the red zone in the past 2 years vs Ohio State. Here's how that could change Saturday, says Steve Sarkisian.
articles.body:
When Texas football coach Steve Sarkisian looks back at his team's two meetings against Ohio State over the past two seasons, one thing jumps off the film when it comes to the Buckeyes having won both hard-fought games.

The red zone. Specifically, when Texas has the ball inside the red zone.

Therefore, it's no surprise that Sarkisian said his No. 5 Longhorns will have to execute better inside the 20-yard line if they hope to knock off No. 1 Ohio State Saturday at Royal-Memorial Stadium and stake their claim to the top spot in the national polls.

"That was probably the difference in the ball games, was our inability to score inside the 10," Sarkisian said Monday during his news conference. "Hopefully this time around, we get more opportunities like that, and we can capitalize on them."

Buckeyes won in red zone in two previous games vs Texas

6:30 p.m. Saturday at Royal-Memorial Stadium.

ABC; 1300 AM, 98.1 FM, 105.3 FM (Spanish).

Two years ago in their College Football Playoff semifinal, Texas scored on one of its two trips inside the 10 in Ohio State's 28-14 win . In comparison, the Buckeyes scored touchdowns both times they reached the red one.

Last year, Texas didn't score either time it penetrated Ohio State's 20-yard line in a 14-7 loss in Columbus, Ohio. The Buckeyes scored in their lone foray into the red area.

So, by even basic journalistic math, that means Texas has gone 1-4 when it comes to scoring against Ohio State in the red zone over the past two seasons while the Buckeyes are 3-3. If the two teams play another slugfest Saturday where points come at a premium, those trips inside the 20-yard line will prove crucial, Sarkisian said.

"I think when it comes to those scenarios, personnel helps, schemes help, the right play call at the right time helps, the mentality helps," he said. "It all adds up, because they've got good scheme, they've got good players, they've got good play callers. So, it's that marriage of those things coming together (and) ultimately, we need to be better in those scenarios."

Cam Coleman , Hollywood Smothers among Texas' offensive additions

The personnel seem better for the Texas offense, considering what Sarkisian and his staff added in the transfer portal in the offseason. Right tackle Melvin Siani and left guards Dylan Sikorski and Laurence Seymore III add some muscle up front. Receiver Cam Coleman and running backs Hollywood Smothers and Raleek Brown bolster the skill spots.

Now, Sarkisian wants to find a way to utilize all of his playmakers for the first time against Ohio State. Last season against the Buckeyes, Texas ran the ball efficiently with 166 yards on 37 carries, but only threw for 170 yards on 30 passes for a meager average of 5.7 yards per attempt. In 2024, Texas threw for 283 yards, but only ran the ball for 58 yards on 29 attempts.

"I've got to find a way to find balance in this game," said Sarkisian, who has been the Longhorns' play-caller since he took over as head coach for the 2021 season. "When you're playing really good teams, which Ohio State is a very good football team, you have to try to find a way to have balance in the game because the coaches are too good, the players are too good, the players are too smart.

"When you become one-dimensional, you're that much easier to stop. And so, finding balance in a game like this is important," he continued. "We hit a few of those passes (last year), I probably feel a little better about me as a play-caller in those games. You don't hit them, I don't feel quite as good. That's kind of the life of a play-caller. That's the way it goes."

In other words, Sarkisian doesn't think his team got muscled around, especially in that pesky red zone.

"I don't think it was about physicality," he said. "I think it was about our inability to execute (and) get points on the board when we had chances."

articles.title: Haaland nets double as Man City beat Porto
articles.summary: Erling Haaland scores twice as Manchester City begin their Champions League campaign with victory against Porto.
articles.body:
Erling Haaland scored twice as Manchester City began their Champions League campaign with a comfortable victory against Porto.

Norway star Haaland scored the only goal against Coventry on Saturday and was the match winner once more, nestling a header into the far corner and rolling home another to take his tally to 36 Champions League goals for City in only 40 appearances.

City have been knocked out by Real Madrid in each of the past three season but their return to Lisbon's Estadio do Dragao - where they lost the 2021 final against Chelsea - was a much more pleasurable experience.

Enzo Maresca's side have started the Premier League season with three straight victories and they controlled this contest, with an impressive showing by teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi 's on his first start for City.

Porto goalkeeper Diogo Costa had an inspired first half, twice denying Haaland with superb reflex saves, while also keeping out efforts from Antoine Semenyo and Phil Foden .

Francesco Farioli's side have won all five league games so far this season but were left frustrated at home and often showed how tough a task they have in Europe, failing to manage a single shot in the opening 45 minutes.

Though Alan Varela curled narrowly wide after his side fell behind to Haaland's opener and William Gomes also screwed off target, they ended the contest without being able to call Gianluigi Donnarumma into action.

The result means 2004 champions Porto have won only two of their past 17 games against English teams in European competition, while City will be aiming to lift the trophy for the first time since their Treble-winning campaign in 2023.

articles.title: Washington football drops two spots in AP Poll after Apple Cup
articles.summary: The Washington Huskies took a slight dip in the AP Poll following their shaky Apple Cup victory to open the 2026 season.
articles.body:
Following a shaky offensive showing in a 24-10 victory over the Washington State Cougars in the Apple Cup, the Washington Huskies saw a slight drop in the first regular-season AP Poll of the 2026 college football campaign.

After slotting in at No. 17 in the preseason, Jedd Fisch's team dropped to No. 19 following a game that it was favored to win by more than three touchdowns and suffered some significant injuries in the process.

Jedd Fisch announced during his Monday press conference that the depth chart's top two running backs, Quaid Carr and Jayden Limar, will both be out several weeks with hand and elbow injuries, respectively, while there's still some mystery surrounding wide receiver Christian Moss, who took just two snaps before suffering a soft tissue injury.

However, the Huskies also saw an elite performance from defensive coordinator Ryan Walters' unit, which looks like it could wind up being one of the nation's best, after holding Washington State without a third-down conversion in the contest and generating the havoc that the coaching staff has been preaching all offseason.

Washington recorded 8 tackles for loss, 5 pass breakups, 3 sacks, and 3 turnovers (2 interceptions and a fumble recovery), while getting impressive contributions from its trio of first-year starters: defensive tackle Derek Colman-Brusa, edge rusher Ramzak Fruean, and nickelback Jeron Jones.

Around the Big Ten, there was plenty of movement, and Washington wound up slotting in as the No. 6 team in the conference, behind No. 1 Ohio State, No. 5 Indiana, No. 6 Oregon, No. 14 USC, and No. 16 Penn State. The Huskies are ahead of No. 21 Iowa, while the Michigan Wolverines dropped out of the poll following their controversial last-second victory over Western Michigan.

articles.summary: The SEC is set to vote on LSU's future in the conference Sept. 10.
articles.body:
Tennessee football's schedule could be impacted by the SEC's ongoing legal battle with LSU .

The SEC claims it has the authority to expel LSU from the conference in an amended complaint on Sept. 8 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Alabama, USA TODAY reported . There will also be a meeting Sept. 10 to vote on the future of LSU's membership in the league, according to the brief.

The No. 18 Vols (1-0) are scheduled to host the No. 8 Tigers (1-0) at Neyland Stadium on Nov. 21. It will be new LSU coach Lane Kiffin's first time back at Neyland Stadium since 2021, which famously ended with Tennessee fans hitting the former UT coach with a golf ball while throwing debris on the field .

Tennessee football vs Furman in Faizon Brandon's debut: See our best photos

The vote follows the SEC filing a lawsuit against LSU and Kiffin on Sept. 3 over player eligibility. Kiffin added former Ole Miss players Zxavian Harris and Dae'Quan Wright, who were on NFL rosters, to his LSU roster after a court order gave them eligibility. Neither Harris or Wright played in the Tigers' blowout win over Clemson in the season opener, which the Tigers won 51-10.

The SEC argues in the briefing that LSU lacks institutional control. The brief supports that argument by citing Kiffin's comments at halftime of the Clemson matchup, when Kiffin "commented that the score differential would have been even greater if LSU had played professional players."

Yahoo's Ross Dellenger reported Sept. 8 reported that 11 of the 16 SEC presidents have to support expulsion for it to pass.

articles.title: Villa take 'big step forward' with win over Brugge
articles.summary: Unai Emery said Aston Villa took "one big step forward" after clinching their first win this season with a 3-2 victory at Club Brugge in their Champions Leag...
articles.body:
Unai Emery said Aston Villa took "one big step forward" after clinching their first win this season with a 3-2 victory at Club Brugge in their Champions League opener on Tuesday.

Emery's side have made a dismal start in the Premier League after a turbulent close-season marred by the departures of many of their Europa League-winning stars.

They are goalless in the top flight and had mustered just one shot on target in their first three matches.

But Villa's opening game of the league phase in Europe's elite club competition provided a welcome tonic as they won for the first time this term.

John McGinn put Villa ahead in the early stages with his team's first goal this season.

Hugo Vetlesen equalised soon afterwards, but Emiliano Buendia restored the visitors' lead before Nicolas Jackson 's first goal for Villa increased their advantage on the stroke of half-time.

Nicolo Tresoldi 's penalty after the interval set up a tense finale, but Villa held firm.

"We took one step forward today and it was very, very important for our confidence and stability," Emery said.

"We had so many chances to get more of an advantage. The second half was a bit more equal.

"When we were 2-0 ahead the confidence was very good, but Brugge scored and we could feel a little bit less confidence than we had in the first half. But we finished well, controlling the game like we planned."

Emery admitted Villa had to sweat it out in the closing stages as Brugge pushed hard for an equaliser.

Tresoldi hit the post and had a header saved from Zion Suzuki in a frantic finale.

"Playing away in Europe is very difficult. They were working with the supporters, who were very excited. They wanted to win," Emery said.

Villa won the Europa League last season to end their 30-year trophy drought, but the team that made history by beating Freiburg in Istanbul has been ripped apart in a matter of months.

Morgan Rogers , Ollie Watkins , Youri Tielemans , Emiliano Martinez , Lucas Digne and Ezri Konsa were all sold in a summer of upheaval.

Villa captain McGinn hailed a gritty performance from a "new" Villa after the Scot became his club's all-time leading scorer in European competitions with 12 goals.

"To get my first Champions League player of the match award aged 31, I'm very happy," he said.

"It was so important to show a real gritty performance and get a victory at a very, very tough place to play. The home supporters were excellent and Brugge are a very impressive club, so to win tonight was huge for us.

"It's a new Villa and it was a big test for the new players to dig in.

"It was Joao Gomes and George Hemmings ' first Champions League games. It's not easy to go away at a place like this in difficult weather conditions.

"Club Brugge were pushing and pushing and pushing and we had to stand strong. We managed to do that."

articles.title: Centurion Guirssay sinks Villarreal again with late brace
articles.summary: Serhou Guirassy scored a late brace to help Borussia Dortmund to an opening matchday victory over Villarreal in the Champions League. The 30-year-old also go...
articles.body:
Serhou Guirassy scored a late brace to help Borussia Dortmund to an opening matchday victory over Villarreal in the Champions League. The 30-year-old also got one past his own goalkeeper in injury-time, but it was too late for the Spaniards.

The visitors had the first two half-chances of the game with headers from Pau Navarro and Tani Oluwaseyi . At the other end, experienced duo Marcel Sabitzer and Guirassy failed to make Borussia Dortmund's first attempt from promising positions before the tenth minute mark.

Chances were few and far between in the next 15 minutes before Dortmund faced another injury blow. Konstantinos Karetsas was forced to be substituted in what was later reported as a circulation problem as Ethan Nwaneri came in his place.

By contrast, the final ten minutes of the first-half were lively as Guirassy had a couple of decent opportunities after Tajon Buchanan tested Gregor Kobel . The Guinean talisman scored his first goal in last season's head-to-head meeting just before the half-time break, and he was close to doing the same.

Dortmund's momentum continued after the restart with Nwaneri's decent effort right away before the England U21 international hit the woodwork in the 50th minute. The Arsenal loanee also had an impact over the weekend after his early introduction in place of the injured Filippo Mane.

However, it was Maximilian Beier 's quick feet that forced an own-goal from Renato Viega on this one. The former Augsburg defender had the last touch after Péter Gulácsi's failed attempt to stop the delivery from the new wingback.

The visitors had the next two best chances through Oluwaseyi and Nicolas Pépé before Kobel made his first save of the game from Georges Mikautadze 's effort. Villarreal scored from the resulting corner-kick with Santiago Mourino's header.

The LaLiga side continued their pressure as Kobel, who needed medical treatment after his first save, made another decisive stop to deny Buchanan. Fábio Silva 's introduction improved Dortmund's attack as Guirassy came close once again to keep his scoring streak.

The 2024/25 joint-top-scorer wasn't going to be denied as he scored a late brace in his 100th Dortmund appearance. The striker was in the right place to restore Dortmund's lead from close range ten minutes before time.

Five minutes later, he scored from a penalty-kick he won himself after Mourino's needless tussle. The former Stuttgart striker repeated his feat from last season with his two goals sinking Villarreal at Westfalenstadion once again.

Gulácsi made another superb stop to deny the brilliant Fábio Silva in the 90th minute to keep the scoreline respectable. Guirassy then beat Kobel from Pépé's free-kick in the game's last meaningful action. The hosts held on to start their European campaign with three points. Dortmund's next game will be against Paderborn as they hope to continue their perfect start to the league season.

articles.title: PLAYER RATINGS | Lille 2-3 Real Betis: Les Dogues lose Champions League opener as Ethan Mbappé sees red
articles.summary: UEFA Champions League, Matchday 1, 08/09/2026Lille lost at home against Real Betis, despite leading twice against the Liga side. The Verdiblancos scored two...
articles.body:
UEFA Champions League, Matchday 1, 08/09/2026

Lille lost at home against Real Betis , despite leading twice against the Liga side. The Verdiblancos scored two goals in three minutes at the start to the second half. Seconds after going behind, Lille went down to 10 men with Ethan Mbappé given his marching orders.

After missing out on last season's Champions League, Lille OSC hosted a Betis side that hasn't competed in Europe's elite for more than twenty years. It was also the meeting of two managerial generations with 37-year-old Davide Ancelotti facing off with Manuel Pellegrini, who will turn 73 next week.

On the pitch, Lille started well, fresh off their convincing start to the Ligue 1 season. A couple of minutes before his older brother's opener for Real Madrid , right-sided Lille winger Ethan Mbappé took centre stage in cutting inside to whip a delicate left-footed cross at the back post, where Ayase Ueda was never going to miss this close to goal.

Lille's attacking trio clicked with Ueda as a traditional target man, Hakon Haraldsson 's work rate and Mbappé's raw skill. Their duo at the back – Nathan Ngoy and Alexsandro – expertly kept Antony and Troy Parrott at bay, delaying Betis' first shot on target until the 33rd minute. Unfortunately, it proved a goal. Tiago Santos left too much time and space for Pablo Fornals to curl a precise cross for Marc Bartra to head home the equalizer.

Outfoxed by the former Barcelona centre-back, Alexsandro only needed three minutes to make amends. The Brazilian outmuscled Isco to power home Gaëtan Perrin's corner kick into Alvaro Vallés' top-left corner. Although they were deservedly ahead, Lille owed their lead to their efficiency, scoring from their two shots on target, and to Troy Parrott's clumsiness. The Ireland international missed a high xG chance to restore parity before the break.

Unfortunately, Lille's serious work in the first half brutally came undone in ten nightmare minutes. First, Bartra equalised, heading home Isco's free-kick. Then, Real Betis pounced on Haraldsson losing possession to send Parrott clear on goal. This time, the Irishman sprayed the ball into Özer's bottom corner. As if it could not have been worse for Lille, VAR caught Mbappé elbowing Natan in the face, leaving the referee no choice but to send him off.

Despite the advantage in numbers, Real Betis barely applied additional pressure, feeling content to let the hosts see more of the ball. Still, the fallout of Lille's collapse early in the second half proved too fatal, despite the introduction of Olivier Giroud from the bench. Les Dogues could have started this Champions League campaign with three points and a trip to the Emirates Stadium to look for. Instead, all they could pick up was deep regrets at how tonight panned out, and they won't rely on Mbappé against Arsenal .

The Turkish goalkeeper had a brilliant game last week against Toulouse , thus retaining Ancelotti's trust. Tonight, he shipped three goals from three shots on target. Sure enough, he's not entirely to blame for Lille's loss, but he lacked authority for Bartra's second header. All in all, indecisive.

The Brazilian centre-back restored Lille's lead, but he should not escape the blame for being outmuscled, not once but twice, by a shorter player in Bartra.

The Algerian international made Lille tick with a tireless midfield shift. He was the Lille player with the most touches in the first half. From the moment he felt unwell with severe headaches, Les Dogues struggled. He was already out of the pitch, replaced by Ngal'ayel Mukau, when the hosts conceded two goals early in the second half.

The 19-year-old younger brother of Kylian Mbappé showcased his extended skillset on the big stage. Drops of the shoulder, dribbles, runs in behind, mazy left-foot… the former PSG player brilliantly assisted Ueda for the opener and made Junior Firpo suffer. But he wasted it all in elbowing Natan in the face, leaving his team short of one man. A petulant exit, and a real shame. He'll miss, at least, Lille's next UCL game at Arsenal's Emirates Stadium.

The Japan international only required 16 minutes to score Lille's sole goal last week against Toulouse off the bench. Tonight, it took him 11 minutes to get on the scoresheet with a simple tap-in at the back post. Should the Japanese continue to average one goal per game, we may not see much of Olivier Giroud this season.

articles.title: Courtois 8.5, Huijsen 7.5 | Real Madrid 2-1 Inter Milan: Player ratings
articles.summary: Real Madrid have started their 2026-27 Champions League campaign with a victory, having narrowly seen off Inter Milan at the Bernabeu. Kylian Mbappe and Fede...
articles.body:
Real Madrid have started their 2026-27 Champions League campaign with a victory, having narrowly seen off Inter Milan at the Bernabeu . Kylian Mbappe and Federico Valverde got the goals for Jose Mourinho's side, who were nowhere near their best against the Nerazzurri, who will feel hard done-by to have come away from the Spanish capital with nothing.

Courtois hasn't been overly busy this season, but he had to be at his best to ensure victory for Real Madrid against Inter. He stopped the Italians from opening the scoring early on, and after his side went into the lead, he produced several top saves to make sure of the three points.

Many expected Dumfries to struggle defensively in Real Madrid's system, and this has certainly been the case so far. Against his former club, he was regularly beaten, with Inter targeting both flanks with great effect. He also failed to track the run of Carlos Augusto for the Inter goal, which was another blip on his record.

He had his lapses, for the most part, this was a better performance from Konate, who has made a relatively underwhelming start to his Real Madrid career. When the ball came into the penalty area, he was often there.

Huijsen has arguably been Real Madrid's best defender in the opening weeks of the season, and this was another good performance. He almost seemed to be in the perfect position to make blocks and clear danger, and right now, he is undroppable for Mourinho.

The first half was difficult for Cucurella, as Inter got a lot of joy down his side – largely due to him having insufficient support. He did relatively well to stop the Nerazzurri's efforts, but it was a struggle.

Trent was Mourinho's solution to having Bernardo Silva , Eduardo Camavinga and Arda Guler unavailable due to suspension, but it did not work. Real Madrid struggled in the midfield battle, with the former Liverpool man, who had only played in the position on a handful of occasions, clearly looking out of place. He also failed to track Lautaro Martinez 's run for Inter's goal.

Valverde struggled without an established midfield partner alongside him, although he did have a positive night after managing to score Real Madrid's second goal following an error from Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez.

Brought in for the suspended Guler, Brahim certainly took his chance. He linked up very well with his fellow Real Madrid forwards, getting the assist for Mbappe's goal and almost accumulating another when Jude Bellingham came close to scoring. The Morocco international was arguably the biggest threat for the hosts, which amplifies how well he did.

Bellingham has started the season in ferocious form, but this was an off-day for him. He had multiple chances to find the back of the net, but a combination of excellent goalkeeping and poor finishing stopped him from getting on the scoresheet.

Vinicius arguably had a better match in defence than attack. He worked hard to try supporting Cucurella, and his efforts were appreciated by the Bernabeu crowd. However, not much happened for him in the forward areas, which would have been a frustration for him.

He may have got his fifth goal of the season, but it was a frustrating night for Mbappe. He had chances to add to his tally, but his finishing was not as good as it usually is. Nevertheless, he made a telling contribution once again.

First appearance of the season for Tchouameni, who struggled to get involved in the game.

Had a couple of nice runs down the right, but his end product was lacking.

Brought on late by Mourinho to see out the victory – although he had to wait to come on after Vinicius took too long in leaving the field of play.

Champions League debut for the young striker, who replaced Mbappe in stoppage time.
